items.title: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley set to reap $113 million from Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley could each collect roughly $113 million in fees for leading Anthropic's (ANT) initial public offering on Thursday.

items.title: Anthropic’s Mega IPO Lives Up to Wall Street Hype but Fails to Revive AI Trade
items.summary: Investors remained wary of tech and AI stocks, as the Nasdaq composite resumed its recent slide, dropping 2.3% on Thursday.

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO nets Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley $113 million apiece in fees, eclipsing their SpaceX paydays
items.summary: The blockbuster public debut delivered one of Wall Street’s largest underwriting paydays in history.

items.title: Jim Cramer’s Warning for Anyone Buying Anthropic Stock: Use a Limit Order
items.summary: Anthropic opened far above its IPO price, then gave back a chunk of that gain within hours. Cramer says one small choice at the buy button separates smart entries from costly ones, and most retail buyers never see it coming.

items.title: Anthropic's Underwriters Had a Record IPO Payday
items.summary: Anthropic's market debut resulted in a record IPO payday for its underwriters, including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.

items.title: U.S. banks have another strong year in sight. But what could go wrong?
